title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, with lower costs per task for heavy and everyday work
summary: OpenAI released two new models on November 17, 2026. GPT-6.2 Astra is built for demanding professional work such as documents, spreadsheets, code and research; GPT-6.2 Sol is a cheaper model for everyday tasks and multistep workflows. Both are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex on paid plans and in the API, priced at $8 and $40 per million input and output tokens for Astra and $2 and $10 for Sol. OpenAI says Astra completes a typical task for under a third of what its predecessor cost. On November 23, a Sol-based version began rolling out to the regular Chat tab, including Business plans.
why: The cost of a finished task keeps falling, so a team already paying for ChatGPT may get more work done on the same plan; check which model your workspace is set to use.
